stories.headline: Aug. 7 marked 90th anniversary of Spanish ‘execution’ of Sacred Heart of Jesus statue
stories.summary: Believers recently observed ninety years since a prominent landmark dedicated to Christ was symbolically shot during Spain’s bitter civil conflict. That following autumn, troops regained control of the location under General Varela’s leadership. To seek spiritual healing, the regiment gathered alongside an army priest to offer a solemn liturgy of restoration.
